retrievalProfile.description: A centered male portrait featuring a ghosted double-exposure silhouette against a desaturated, cool-toned background with top-aligned serif typography.
triggerTerms: double exposure portrait with ghosted silhouette

recipe.visualDefinition: A central figure in a brown suede or leather jacket stands against a pale, desaturated blue-grey background. A secondary, translucent 'ghost' image of the same figure is offset to the left, creating a sense of duality. The lighting is soft and diffused, with a vintage film grain and slight vignetting. Text is clustered at the top center in a clean, spaced-out serif font.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered with ghosted offset silhouette
Cool-toned background contrasting with warm-toned jacket
Soft, low-contrast lighting across the entire frame

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Primary subject is centered vertically and horizontally, occupying the middle two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the dark texture of the jacket.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top-center text, moves down to the subject's face, then follows the ghosted silhouette to the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample negative space on the left and right sides, filled with a soft gradient and grain.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with muted mid-tones and soft highlights.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family with varying scales and tracking.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary stroke contrast and sharp serifs.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a man in a brown suede jacket against a desaturated pale blue background. Apply a double exposure effect where a translucent silhouette of the man is offset to the left. Add film grain and a subtle aged paper texture.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add three levels of centered, uppercase serif text at the top. The top line should be small, the second line medium, and the third line the largest with wide tracking. Use a dark charcoal color for the text.

verificationChecks: Is the double exposure translucent and offset?
Is the background a desaturated, cool blue-grey?
Is the text centered and top-aligned?
Is there a visible film grain texture?

mustRedesign: Specific artist name and album title
Record label logo in the bottom corner
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the ghosted image doesn't obscure the main face
Confirm the color palette remains muted and cool
recipe.reuseFormula: Centered Subject + Ghosted Offset Silhouette + Desaturated Cool Background + Top-Aligned Wide-Tracked Serif Typography = 70s Folk Aesthetic
